title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR), STAIR PLANK (3RD STEP), DEAD BUG, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, WALL CHEST OPENER, FIGURE-FOUR. STRAIGHT BACK TO WORK AFTER THE WEEKEND.

script.welcome: TUESDAY, GRIMES. PUSH AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. PUSH UPS ON THE STAIRS, A PLANK, A DEAD BUG, A BALANCE TEST, THEN WE OPEN THE CHEST AND THE HIPS. THE SCALE SAID TWO THIRTY THREE AND THE SCALE IS NOT IMPRESSED, SO TODAY WE SHOW IT SOME DISCIPLINE. UP. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. HANDS OFF THE KEYBOARD. THAT EMAIL HAS WAITED THIS LONG, IT CAN WAIT TWO MORE MINUTES.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT COUNT. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. ARMS PUSHED, CORE BRACED, BALANCE TESTED, CHEST AND HIPS OPEN. THAT IS A MAN WHO WILL STILL GET HIMSELF OFF THE FLOOR AT NINETY. NOW GO AND EAT A PROPER LUNCH WITH SOME PROTEIN IN IT, NOT A FISTFUL OF BLOODY CRACKERS.
script.pause: HOLD. AND STAY AWAY FROM THE BISCUIT TIN.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, A BIT WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. BODY ONE STRAIGHT LINE FROM HEAD TO HEELS, GLUTES SQUEEZED. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE EDGE OF THE STEP, ELBOWS AT ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS AWAY. STEADY PACE FOR 30 SECONDS. QUALITY OVER COUNT.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH. STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS. CHEST TO THE STEP. PRESS AWAY. IF YOUR BACKSIDE IS STICKING UP IN THE AIR I WILL SEE IT, AND I WILL SAY SOMETHING RUDE.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. SHAKE THE ARMS OUT. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST AWAKE. GOOD MAN.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STEP)
exercises.cue: FOREARMS OR HANDS ON THE 3RD STEP, FEET BACK ON THE FLOOR. ONE STRAIGHT LINE, RIBS DOWN, GLUTES SQUEEZED, BREATHE STEADY. HIPS NEITHER SAGGING NOR PIKED. HOLD 12 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANK. THIRD STEP. THREE ROUNDS. TWELVE SECONDS. RIBS DOWN. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES. KEEP BREATHING. HOLDING YOUR BREATH IS NOT A CORE EXERCISE, IT IS JUST GOING PURPLE.
exercises.speakDone: PLANK DONE. SOLID AS A GATEPOST. GOOD.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, ARMS STRAIGHT UP, KNEES BENT AT 90 OVER THE HIPS. PRESS THE LOW BACK INTO THE FLOOR. SLOWLY LOWER THE OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG TOWARD THE FLOOR, BREATHE OUT, RETURN. ALTERNATE. LOW BACK STAYS DOWN THE WHOLE TIME.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. ON YOUR BACK. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK FLAT TO THE FLOOR. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG OUT, SLOW. BREATHE OUT. BACK IN. YES, YOU LOOK LIKE A BEETLE ON ITS BACK. NOBODY IS FILMING. PROBABLY.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUG DONE. CORE SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LEVEL WITH THE BACK. HOLD 3 SECONDS, HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR, NO WOBBLE. RETURN SLOW, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. YOUR BALANCE TEST. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH SIDE. ARM FORWARD, OPPOSITE LEG BACK. HOLD FOR THREE. HIPS SQUARE. IF YOU WOBBLE, GOOD, THAT IS THE BALANCE GETTING BETTER. FALL OVER AND I'LL LAUGH, THEN HELP YOU UP.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: SIDE ON TO THE WALL. PALM AND FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AND FEET AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE STRETCH ACROSS THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. SHOULDER DOWN, BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN AWAY SLOW. SHOULDER DOWN. UNDO ALL THAT HUNCHING OVER THE DESK LIKE A GARGOYLE.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. STANDING TALLER ALREADY. GOOD.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP OPENER
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD THE HANDS BEHIND THE SUPPORTING THIGH AND GENTLY DRAW IT TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE. HEAD AND SHOULDERS RELAXED. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. ON YOUR BACK. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER THE KNEE. DRAW THE LEG IN. HEAD DOWN, SHOULDERS LOOSE. LET THE HIP OPEN. THIS IS THE NICE BIT, SO DO NOT FALL ASLEEP ON MY FLOOR.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. ON YOUR FEET AND GO EARN YOUR LUNCH.
